name: Crazy for Yun
original_name: クレイジー・フォー・ゆん
source:
"I got a new start with a girl I loved since forever.
No snickering audience this time, prepared to fail, I opened my heart.
Yessss! Success!
What's more, she invited me to spend the night with her.
Things are definitely going to happen."

For three years he's pined for her. Tonight, months of accumulated "love"
are going to blow all over her pretty face!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE048259.html]DLsite English[/url]]
